diagnosis.root_cause:
The curl command calling https://httpstat.us/500 received an empty reply from the server and exited with code 52. The Log Analyst extracted the exact error: "curl: (52) Empty reply from server" followed by exit code 52. This error occurs when the TCP connection succeeds but the remote server closes it without sending any HTTP data.

The External Analyst found that httpstat.us has documented reliability issues, specifically GitHub issue #135 noting the service has been offline and recommending alternatives like http-stat.us. The History Analyst confirmed this is a recurring problem, finding issue #111 with the identical failure (curl error 52 calling httpstat.us/500 in the same workflow) and issue #52 with the same error pattern in a different workflow—both issues remain open.

While the Config & Change Analyst noted the --fail flag will cause curl to exit on HTTP 5xx responses, the actual failure is curl error 52 (empty reply), not error 22 (HTTP error with --fail). This indicates the server never sent an HTTP response at all. The recent commits are only automated data appends with [skip ci] flags and do not modify any code that would affect this test.
diagnosis.suggested_fix: Replace the unreliable httpstat.us service with a more stable alternative. The External Analyst found http-stat.us (note the hyphen) recommended as a replacement. Update the workflow step to use https://http-stat.us/500 instead of https://httpstat.us/500. Alternatively, consider using httpbin.org/status/500 or postman-echo.com/status/500, both of which are more reliable third-party testing services. After switching, monitor the workflow to confirm the new endpoint is stable.

findings.step_purpose: Call an endpoint (https://httpstat.us/500) that returns a real HTTP 500 error using curl with --fail and --max-time 10 flags
findings.config_issue: The workflow uses curl with the --fail flag which causes curl to exit with error 22 on HTTP errors (4xx/5xx). However, the endpoint is expected to return HTTP 500, so the --fail flag will always cause the step to fail. This appears to be a configuration issue unless the intent is to test failure handling. Additionally, curl error 52 (empty reply) suggests the remote server may not have responded at all, possibly due to service unavailability or network issues.

findings.known_issue_on_web: Curl error 52 'Empty reply from server' occurs when the TCP connection succeeds but the server closes the connection without sending any HTTP data. Multiple sources confirm httpstat.us has had reliability issues, with GitHub issue #135 noting the service has been offline and suggesting alternatives like http-stat.us. This appears to be a known intermittent problem with the external test service httpstat.us rather than a code or configuration issue.
findings.notes: GitHub status shows no current incidents. The error is specific to calling the external testing service httpstat.us/500, which has documented reliability problems. The curl error 52 indicates the server accepted the connection but sent no data before closing, which is consistent with server-side issues at httpstat.us. This is not a problem with the repository's code but with the external dependency on an unreliable third-party testing service. Status checks reflect current status only, not the time of failure.

Issue #111 is directly related to the same workflow (server_error_test.yml) and involves curl error 52 with empty reply from server when calling httpstat.us/500. Issue #52 also mentions curl error 52 empty reply but from a different workflow (ci.yml). Both issues are currently open.
